text: 1. Why choose to study this program in Software College (SC)? English Taught Program Collaborate with International IT Enterprises Professional and Personal Support ProfoundChinese Culture Low Expenses 2. Program Objectives A firm grasp of the basic theory and systematic professional knowledge of software engineering and computer science. Be familiar with and master research trends, advanced technical methods and technical means in the professional field. Have the ability to engage in scientific research, teaching or specialized technical work. 3. Main Courses ○ Mathematical statistics & application ○ Numerical analysis ○ Literature review and academic seminars ○ Advanced software engineering ○ Object-oriented system analysis and design(Java) ○ Software process improvement and management(CMM) ○ Service computing ○ Advanced project training ○ Advanced Java programming ○ Network & information security technology ○ Data warehouse and data mining ○ Advanced artificial intelligence ○ Virtual reality and human interaction technology ○ Mobile cloud computing ○ Chinese language ○ Chinese culture Note: All the courses(except Chinese language) are given in English. 95% major courses are given by foreign teachers from USA, UK or Ireland. 4. Duration The full-time scheme for the programs lasts for 2.5 years.(1 year for courses learning, 0.5 year or more for internship, 1 year for thesis) 5.Degree Awarded Qualified student will be granted Master Degree of SoftwareEngineeringbyNortheastern University 6. Faculty NEU is one of the top universities in China, it is also one of “211 Project” and “985 Project” universities. Our college is one of the 37 National Pilot Software Colleges granted by the Chinese Ministry of Education. Our faculty members come from all over the world and half of them have a strong software industry background. In addition, the international cooperation office of our college will provide services for the overseas students. 7.Research Area Software service technology and applications Cloud computing technology and applications Mobile Internet technology and applications Network information system security technology and applications Online games and animation technology Chaos fractal and complex network technology 8. Future Career The Software College excels in strengthening students’ practical ability and enhancing their adaptability for future work. Consequently, all undergraduate students join different companies in the 7th semester for internships and further practical training. The Software College cooperates closely with companies at home and abroad and hasestablished joint laboratories with IBM and Neusoft, etc. Off-campus practice bases have been founded in more than 20 companies, including IBM, Alibaba, Baidu, etc.
